title: Run staged diff hygiene before the x1 freeze
trigger_preconditions: the exact x1 file set is staged
Git can inspect whitespace errors without mutating files
failure_signature: The first staged diff hygiene check reported an extra blank line at the end of the v645-v4 definitions module.
candidate_workaround: Run exact staged diff hygiene after generated and hand-authored x1 files are stable, then repair only the reported owner-scoped whitespace defect.
recurrence_guard: Require git diff --cached --check to return zero before every phase commit.
rollback: Keep the commit blocked and retain the finding if normalization would alter semantic content.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
